integrity: The foundational publication date and equation provenance were verified from bibliographic records and an authoritative model account. Modern rigorous same-object work was inspected for the positive history-space semiflow, stable periodic orbits, bifurcations, chaos, and computer-assisted periodic-orbit proofs. Targeted same-object searches covered invariant measure, conditional expectation, variance, stationary average, and derivative-speed formulations. The accepted regression, variance defect, equilibrium equality class, and local slope obstruction were independently reconstructed and the numerical specialization was replayed with the packaged checker.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns compactly supported invariant probability measures on the positive continuous-history phase space.
The support-dependent slope condition is necessary, not sufficient, for non-equilibrium recurrent dynamics.
The classical numerical intervals are slope-obstruction intervals rather than bifurcation thresholds.
The original 1977 article is used for provenance and date rather than whole-document noncoverage.
A short equivalent stationary identity could remain in unindexed delay-equation literature.
title: Exact delayed-feedback regression and variance defect in the Mackey–Glass equation
